name: NJ_State_Park_Service_Trails_h
title: Parks and Forests Trail System for New Jersey State Park Service
description: This data set contains over 1,000 miles of official recreational trails on land owned and managed by New Jersey State Parks (NJSP). Data collection was a cooperative effort between New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection (NJDEP) employees, volunteers, Dovetail Trail Consulting, and non-profit agencies resulting in varying degrees of spatial accuracy and detail. Due to the varied mapping sources this data is not intended for orienteering purposes.
snippet: The purpose is to provide NJSP with a manageable, graphic inventory of trails within the NJSPS system. Besides in-house trail management this data was created for the production of trail maps for hikers, bikers, and horseback riders for safe navigation through official trails in the NJSP. Objective accessibility information was also added for users to determine whether a trail would be user-friendly for them based on their own abilities. These maps are available at https://dep.nj.gov/parksandforests. The data has value to the public, federal, state, county and municipal government agencies, trail organizations and non-profits for local and regional planning decisions for outings, constructing trail connections, land acquisition for trail corridors etc… This data is not intended for orienteering purposes.
licenseInfo: This data should not be used for orienteering purposes even though the trails have been reviewed for accuracy. Trails may be altered or closed depending on weather conditions, always check https://www.nj.gov/dep/parksandforests/parks/park_advisories_web.html for the most up to date trail information.
